question: What do Samsung Galaxy Note 9 owners say about how long a charge lasts?
answer:
One reviewer said the Galaxy Note 9's battery lasts around 24 hours with moderate to high use. [938aeb0a504f_0]
Another reviewer said the battery keeps going even with long periods of use and charges it every 1.5 days. [2a4b1ccd5f90_0]
A different reviewer said the battery lasts all day at least for how they use it. [86b0cffc8d81_0]
One reviewer said the Note 9's battery is worse than the Note 4's and does not last longer despite charging faster. [279e1dee4173_0]
Another reviewer said the Note 9's battery is bad and lasts less than their Note 8's. [435a77ad61f1_0]
One reviewer said AccuBattery Pro reported only about 80% battery capacity and called battery life one of the great advantages of the Note 9. [3342ded09c6c_0]
